Global AI Investment to Reach $1 Trillion by 2026, Goldman Sachs Predicts

Global investment in artificial intelligence is projected to reach $1 trillion by 2026, according to a report by Goldman Sachs. By 2028, AI investment is expected to constitute 1.4% of the global Gross Domestic Product (GDP). While corporate spending on AI is accelerating, its immediate impact on earnings remains limited. The report highlights the significant growth trajectory of AI investment worldwide.
